title: Hypotension Prediction Index evaluated on non-invasive arterial pressure waveforms
summary: A machine-learning-derived Hypotension Prediction Index was re-evaluated on ClearSight non-invasive waveforms from a trial of 320 adults aged 45 or older at moderate-to-high risk in non-cardiac surgery. It predicted hypotension 5 minutes ahead with sensitivity 0.86 (95% CI 0.82-0.89) and specificity 0.86, and 0.83 for both at 10 minutes. This is a re-analysis of existing trial data for a proprietary algorithm, and clinical benefit is not shown.
ai_technology: Machine-learning-derived Hypotension Prediction Index applied to non-invasive arterial waveform estimates

evidence.tested: Sensitivity, specificity and positive predictive value (0.83 at an index threshold of 85) were calculated on trial data from 320 patients.
evidence.unknown: Reduction of hypotension in practice is not tested; the algorithm was developed on invasive waveforms and is proprietary. Abstract-based; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: A machine-learning algorithm predicts intraoperative hypotension minutes ahead from the arterial pressure waveform.
